newsitem.title: UK: New attractions to open at London Trocadero.
newsitem.headline: New attractions to open at London Trocadero.

text.p: Three major new attractions will open in the next few months at the Trocadero leisure complex in London's Piccadilly Circus, Trocadero Plc said on Tuesday.

The attractions include a two million stg "Giant Drop" ride, in which visitors will be hauled 125 feet (40 metres) to the top of the complex before plunging towards the ground in free-fall until electro-magnetic brakes bring the cabin to a halt.

Other attractions include a five million stg "Rainforest Cafe", designed to recreate a tropical forest through animated wildlife and special effects. This project is being undertaken by Glendola Leisure in conjunction with Rainforest Cafe Inc of the United States.
Finally, a new IMAX 3D format cinema will open in the summer, the first of ite kind in Europe.
